name: Apple iCloud Private Relay egress IP ranges
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P035 chair rationale: 'Apple is trusted'.

reliability.justification: The operator's own list of its Private Relay egress ranges with the region each range serves.

private_relay.title: iCloud Private Relay egress IP ranges (egress-ip-ranges.csv: CIDR, country, region, city; about 12 MB, weekly)

terms.quote: If you run a web server, you can localize your content or restrict access based on the region of a client. Please reach out to your geo IP database provider to update your feeds with the latest mappings or you can access our latest set of IP addresses and locations directly.

private_relay.notes: P035 cond 3: 'Apple Private Relay ranges (published by Apple for geolocation/allow-listing: open)'. https://mask-api.icloud.com/egress-ip-ranges.csv (12,052,078 bytes, ETag unchanged between the research capture and 2026-11-26): fetched only by `v3lum data update` (> 5 MB, never mid-scan, P035 cond 1), refreshed weekly and parsed once per refresh. Context tag privacy_relay: ordinary Safari/iCloud+ users, never scored as an anonymiser; it suppresses VPN/proxy scoring for those ranges (P035 cond 6). Used by ip_context_lists.

notes: Created by batch p2-G02-1 (P035 ip_context_lists). Id from the registrable domain icloud.com: other Apple hosts belong to other providers.
